mentions.name: StitchWink
mentions.description: AI-powered cross-stitch pattern generator that produces real, usable cross-stitch patterns rather than raw image-generation output. Patterns can be edited manually or through text and images with AI.
mentions.problem: Using image generation directly does not produce real cross-stitch patterns.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I created an ai cross-stitch pattern generating tool: https://stitchwink.com/admin

If you try to use image generation directly, you don't get real patterns. StitchWink makes real patterns that you can also edit manually or through text/images with AI.
mentions.author: dumbfoundded
